descriptor.scene: THE MANAGER STAYS INSIDE HIS GLOWING MACHINE and June never enters it; they are in two places in one frame and no figure crosses between them. The camera is well back inside the machine in bright warm MORNING light and the PLACE is the subject: the whole factory interior lit gold, rails clean, machines waiting, everything ready. At the CENTRE the FLOOR IS OPENING: two broad honey-wood floor panels swing down and apart on brass hinges at the head of the rails, opening a wide warm way down into the working factory below, amber light rising through the opening. The manager stands at the lip of it at full length and no taller than a third of the frame height, turned three-quarter, one mitten arm raised and extended toward the opening floor, head up, weight forward, his cream newsboy cap on his head, his plum glow bright inside the morning gold. At the LEFT of the frame, set into the cream wall, a tall warm OVAL OPENING like a window of daylight: inside it, painted as a real place, June on her wooden porch in early morning sun, from the waist up, speaking a new voice note into a plain modern smartphone held close to her mouth, her other hand over her heart. From that opening a SMALL FLOATING VOICE-NOTE SHAPE, a soft rounded glowing bubble carrying one simple little waveform, drifts in toward the manager. Morning gold everywhere, warm and awake and beginning. Composition: the oval opening and June at the left, the opening floor and the manager centre-right; the upper right stays calm sunlit wall.
descriptor._caption: In the morning there is a new voice note. June asks for something braver than yesterday, because yesterday came true. The manager tips his cap and opens the floor. His factory is ready. It is better every morning.
negatives: the manager standing on the porch, outside his machine, or at June's scale

eyeglasses on June, on her face, pushed up on her head or on a cord
June's hair worn down or cut short; it is a low silver bun at the nape
a hard-edged panel border, gutter or split-screen line between the two places
evening, dusk or night light; this is bright warm morning
